name: Safety First
summary: Shreev has done what Razzeric wanted with the seaforium booster, and you carry the modified booster back to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats. Shreev's warning with it: be careful when setting it off, because one slip and Razzeric ends up a scorch mark on the track. This follows the first Safety First.

sections.title: A Warning from Shreev
sections.body: Shreev hands over the modified booster, done as Razzeric asked. Shreev's warning with it: Razzeric needs to be careful when he sets it off. A single slip and he will not be racing ahead; he will be a scorch mark on the track. Shreev adds that it would be a shame, wondering whether the nineteenth driver would have been any good.

sections.title: Sand Under the Seat
sections.body: Back on the Shimmering Flats, Razzeric is grumbling about Pozzik, who loaded a bucket of sand onto the racer. How, Razzeric asks, is he meant to reach top speed with sand beneath the seat?

sections.title: The Booster Returned
sections.body: Razzeric is pleased with the modified booster. He wishes he could watch the gnomes' faces when he sets it off, though he expects to be far too busy setting a new course record.

faq.q: Who sends the modified booster back to the flats?
faq.answer: Shreev finishes the work on the seaforium booster in Gadgetzan and gives it to you to carry back to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
Shreev says Razzeric should be careful when setting the booster off. A single slip and he will not race ahead; he will be a scorch mark on the track.

faq.q: Why is Razzeric upset about his vehicle?
faq.answer: Pozzik loaded a bucket of sand onto the racer, and Razzeric asks how he can reach top speed with sand beneath the seat.
